title: Hybrid GA components, round 3, part 1: 1M evaluations
question: Which components of the hybrid GA are conclusively worth keeping, and which are not? Round 1 (pecto-hga-vs-aco parts 5-6) removed one mechanism at a time from the full GA, at equal evaluations, on 5 instances generated with instance seed 42, with SA and local-search settings chosen without tuning. Round 3 checks every verdict against the four reasons it could be wrong: interactions (it ablates around the reduced GA, removing each kept part and adding back each dropped part), budget type (1M evaluations and 300 s), settings (three SA schedules, three local-search budgets) and generalization (new instances, instance seed 43, and new run seeds).
hypothesis: From round 1 at 1M evaluations (gap of removing the component from the full GA): seeding +10.2 %, best-insertion repair +11.6 %, recombination +4.7 %, cheaper-route bias +1.5 %, local search +0.27 %, tournament-only -2.45 % vs the mix, mutation -0.17 %, stagnation response -0.16 %, SA -0.03 %, age protection +0.06 % (inconclusive). Expected in round 3: seeding, repair, recombination and tournament selection are essential around R too and on the new instances; the cheaper-route bias stays essential on the large instances; local search stays useful with some budget (not necessarily 10); adding back mutation, the stagnation response or SA does not help at 1M evaluations with any of the tested SA schedules; at 300 s, SA's cheap evaluations may make R+SAlight or R+SA competitive (equal-time effect); age protection stays inconclusive.
analysisPlan: Two experiments: pecto-hga-components-r3-1-1m (16 configurations, 1,000,000 evaluations) and pecto-hga-components-r3-2-300s (the 8 configurations whose evaluations cost differently: reduced, full, R-LS, the three SA variants, R+LS3, R+LS30; 300 s wall time). Instances: C100 (custom 10 ambulances / 100 patients / 5 hospitals x 30 beds) and Table I 1, 4, 7, 10, all generated with instance seed 43 (new instances, same sizes as rounds 1-2); run seeds base 20261028, repeats 0-9. Baseline 'reduced' (R): mixed greedy seeding, ARX (cheaper-route 0.75, best insertion), local search 10 steps, tournament-only selection, no mutation, no stagnation response, no SA, age protection 3. PRIMARY, per budget and variant over the 50 pairs (same instance and repeat): paired gap (variant - R) / R in %, mean with 95 % t-interval, better/worse, exact Wilcoxon signed-rank, Holm over the variants of that budget (15 at 1M, 7 at 300 s); per instance descriptive. The final classification combines round 1 (part 6, computed from its data) and round 3, per component. SECONDARY: full vs reduced (replication of round 2 on new instances); setting sensitivity of SA and local search; activity at the end (duplicates, diversity, evaluations per second, generations). Analysis script: analyze.py in the folder of pecto-hga-components-r3-1-1m, written before any result.
decisionRule: Per budget, for a KEPT component (variant R-x): it is NEEDED if R-x is significantly worse (Holm p < 0.05, mean gap >= +0.1 %); NOT NEEDED if the upper end of the 95 % interval of the mean gap is below +0.1 %; else UNDECIDED. For a DROPPED component (R+x): it HELPS if R+x is significantly better (Holm p < 0.05, mean gap <= -0.1 %); it DOES NOT HELP if the lower end of the 95 % interval is above -0.1 % (adding it gains less than 0.1 %); else UNDECIDED. SA and local search are judged on their best tested setting: SA helps if any of R+SA, R+SAlight, R+SAstrong helps; local search is needed if R-LS is worse than R (and its setting sensitivity is reported from R+LS3 / R+LS30). FINAL, per component, decided by round 3 (new data, and the reduced GA is the design being kept): WORTH KEEPING if NEEDED (or, for a dropped component, HELPS) at every budget it was tested at; NOT WORTH KEEPING if NOT NEEDED / DOES NOT HELP at every tested budget; BUDGET-DEPENDENT if it is worth keeping at one budget and not at the other; otherwise UNDECIDED. Round 1 is reported beside it: CONFIRMED if round 1 points the same way, CONTRADICTS ROUND 1 otherwise (an interaction with the removed mechanisms or an instance effect), and NEW if round 1 was inconclusive. The 1M verdict covers every component; the 300 s verdict only those tested at 300 s. Conclusions go in the journal of pecto-hga-components-r3-1-1m.
